Staff Vacancy
Saturday, 06 May 2023
15287 Hits
Applications on plain paper enclosed with the certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience are invited for the below mentioned posts which must reach to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Po. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 latest by
22/05/2023
.
Registration with Local Employment Exchange is mandatory, copy of the same to be submitted along with application
.
Assistant Embryologist: 1 Post (Open Category – 1)
Qualification
&
Experience:
The candidate should be B.Sc. or BV Sc. with at least five years of experience in Assisted Reproductive Technology, intrauterine insemination and other techniques of ART, should have worked in an IUI lab of a Hospital with more than 500 beds.
Radiotherapy Technician: 2 Posts (1 VJNT, 1 OPEN)
Qualification
&
Experience:
B.Sc. (Physics)/B.Sc. (Medical Imaging Technology) with Post Graduate Diploma in Radiotherapy Technology or B.Sc. (Radiotherapy Technology) from a recognized Institute / University approved by AERB.
MRI / CT Scan Technician: 2 Posts (1 SC, 1 EWS)
Qualification
&
Experience:
B.Sc. in Medical Radiography and Imaging Technology. M.Sc. in Medical Imaging Technology will be preferred must have 5 years experience in CT, MRI, Radiography in a Medical College or in a Hospital with 500 or more beds. MSCIT with proficiency in operating computers.
Laboratory Technician:
3 Posts (1 ST, 2 Open)
Qualification
&
Experience:
B.Sc. with DMLT from Govt. recognized Institute approved by State Technical Board / University with at least two years’ experience in a Medical College or in a Hospital with 500 or more beds.
5
.
Laboratory Assistant: 4 Posts (1 SC, 1 OBC, 2 Open)
Qualification
&
Experience:
HSSC (Science) with DMLT from Govt. recognized Institute with 2 years’ experience in a Medical College or in 500 bedded hospital
Junior Clerk cum Data Entry Operator:
10 Posts (7 Open, 1 ST, 1 VJNT, 1 EWS)
Qualification
&
Experience:
Graduation from Govt. recognized Institute approved by University, MSCIT with proficiency in operating computers and two years’ experience as Clerk in a Medical College or in a Hospital with 500 or more beds.
Assistant Store Keeper: 1 Post (Open)
Qualification
&
Experience:
Graduation in Commerce from recognized Institute / University, 3 years’ experience in reputed Institute/Organization, MSCIT with knowledge and proficiency in operating Computer, Knowledge of Government Purchase Norms and maintaining Records of inventory in an organization having minimum turnover of Rs.3 crore.
Gas Plant Operator: 1 Post (Category 1 OPEN)
Qualification & Experience:
HSSC
+
ITI, Fitter/welder with mandatory experience in operating & maintaining Oxygen gas plant (Liquid, PSA and Manifold oxygen plant) in a Hospital with more than 500 beds. Person experienced in maintenance of Air compressor, vacuum pump and air dryer machine will be preferred.
Receptionist cum Counsellor: 1 Post (SC Category – 1)
Qualification & Experience:
The candidate should be graduate / post graduate in social work / social science, should have completed MSCIT, should have experience of five years in a Hospital with more than 500 beds.
Carpenter: 1 Post (Open)
Qualification
&
Experience:
SSC and Diploma or Certificate in Carpentry from Govt. approved Institute or ITI (2 years course) with experience of at least one year experience with an organization having turnover of Rs.50.00 lacs.
Plumber: 1 Post (Open)
Qualification & Experience:
SSC with ITI (two years course) from Directorate of Vocational Education & Training (Maharashtra State) or equivalent. Candidate must have 2 years Experience in the field at reputed organization or with A/B Class Contractor.
Mason: 1 Post (Open)
Qualification & Experience:
SSC with experience of construction field for at least 5 years in a Construction Company or with A/B Class Contractor.
Salary:
As per Kasturba Health Society’s Rules
Age Limit
: Between 18 to 38 years for General Candidate/ between 18-43 for reserved candidate
Note:
1. Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age
limit. Experience can be relaxed for exceptionally good candidate.
Decision of Selection Committee will be final.
No. of posts may vary.
DEAN
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
